text: Ha, can you believe we actually did it? We made it through the storm, wind howling, rain lashing. I thought we'd never see the sun again. There were nights, nights I cried myself to sleep, whispering, is anyone even out there? But then you showed up. You smiled, and suddenly the world wasn't so dark. I felt seen, understood. Remember that silly dance in the kitchen with the burnt pancakes? Oh, we were a mess. But now, now you're gone. The silence is deafening. I miss you every single day. But I carry you with me, in every laugh, every tear, every quiet moment. And I'll keep going, because that's what you'd want. Always.
